race.comment: PALTINIAN (4) was only beaten a nose at Dunkeld after racing wide early, and his third in an Open at Wycheproof two back adds a useful class reference. He is proven around this trip and looks a key danger. I'MFALLINFORYOU (8) had no clear running until the 100m at Geelong yet was beaten just under two lengths, while her Moe maiden win prior showed she can finish over the top when given clear air. Will be finishing strongly. KING KAUFFO (1) is very consistent and right in the mix again. MANNERHEIM (2) has been better of late and comes into the mix after some key scratchings. Draws well for Spain and is worth keeping safe for a minor spot.
